'''Attack Formation Zeta Nine''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] tactic used by the the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Force]] [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] against [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>. It valued [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] over firepower.<ref name="Starships">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)]]</ref>
